title: Apollo 8 launched on the winter solstice

tellings.quote: It launched on December 21st, 1968, the winter solstice, the day the sun is symbolically reborn after the longest night of the year.

plain: Apollo 8, the NASA mission that flew to lunar orbit, lifted off on December 21st, 1968, the winter solstice, which Michels calls "the day the sun is symbolically reborn after the longest night of the year." He offers this himself, without naming a source, in an episode on what he sees as pagan ritual inside NASA. If the date was chosen on purpose, it would suggest the space programme was timed to old sun symbolism.
